units.source_text: 家里那个人和单位里的同事，简直可以说也是这么一回事。

en.t: The person at home and his colleagues at work could almost be said to be exactly the same sort of thing.

units.source_text: 要说之前回忆起的东西，那只有异样扩大的细部：

en.t: As for what he had recalled earlier, there were only strangely enlarged details:

units.source_text: 肉质厚厚的鼻孔……皱皱巴巴的嘴唇……平平的薄唇……平平的手指……

en.t: thick fleshy nostrils... wrinkled lips... flat thin lips... flat fingers...

units.source_text: 尖尖的手指……眼睛里的星星……锁骨之下，线头一样的疙瘩……乳房上延展的紫罗兰色静脉……

en.t: pointed fingers... stars in the eyes... a threadlike lump below the collarbone... violet veins spreading across the breast...

units.source_text: 就只有这些部分，不由分说地逼近过来，引得他一阵恶心。

en.t: Only these parts pressed in on him without asking permission, making him feel a wave of nausea.

units.source_text: 然而，装上了广角镜的眼睛，看什么东西都小得像虫子似的。

en.t: Yet through eyes fitted with a wide angle lens, everything looked as tiny as an insect.

units.source_text: 趴在那儿的，是在办公室里喝功夫茶的同事们。

en.t: The ones sprawled there were his colleagues drinking gongfu tea in the office.

units.source_text: 贴着那边角落的是一张小床，

en.t: Pressed against the far corner was a small bed,

units.source_text: 裸体的那个人躺在潮湿的床上，香烟灰眼看着就要掉下来了，

en.t: and that naked person lay on the damp bed, the cigarette ash looking as if it would fall at any moment,

units.source_text: 她仍迷迷糊糊躺着，身子一动也不动。

en.t: while she still lay there in a daze, without moving her body at all.

units.source_text: 他没有一点嫉妒的心思，他只是把这些小小的虫子想象成“点心型”的。

en.t: He felt no jealousy at all; he merely imagined these tiny insects as being shaped like sweets.

units.source_text: 所谓点心型的，就是有轮廓而没有内容的东西。

en.t: By sweet shaped, he meant something that had an outline but no substance inside.

units.source_text: 然而，与此相配合也不需要正宗的点心师，去烤制没有下订单的点心，

en.t: Yet to go along with that, there was no need for a genuine pastry chef to bake sweets that no one had ordered,

units.source_text: 即使再一次恢复关系，那也得将过去的一切一笔勾销之后从头再来。

en.t: and even if the relationship were restored once more, they would have to wipe out everything in the past and start again from the beginning.

units.source_text: 沙子的变化，同时也是他的变化。

en.t: The change in the sand was at the same time a change in him.

units.source_text: 也许他从沙子中，和水一起，捡回了另一个自己。

en.t: Perhaps from the sand, together with the water, he had picked up another self.
